question: Did FOUR beat or miss its end to end payment volume guidance at midpoint for Q3 2024 provided in Q1 2024? Express as % BEAT or MISS
model_answer:
Content truncated; fetch the document directly.**MISS of about 7.4%.**

- **Guidance:** In Q1 2024, Shift4 (FOUR) guided Q3 2024 end-to-end (E2E) payment volume to $46.0B–$48.0B, per the quarterly breakdown in its Q1 shareholder letter. The midpoint is $47.0B.
- **Actual:** Q3 2024 E2E payment volume was $43.5 billion, up 56% from Q3 2023.
- **Result:** ($43.5B − $47.0B) / $47.0B ≈ **−7.4%**, a miss against the midpoint. It was also below the low end of the range, by about 5.4%.

The company also lowered its full-year volume guidance to $164 billion–$166 billion (prior $167 billion–$172 billion).
judge_reason: Model gives a 7.4% MISS against the Q3 2024 E2E volume guidance midpoint, matching the official answer in value and direction.
